page.layout: One page of text. Left margin holds one note, "Prima Sectio," beside the heading "SECTIO PRIMA." Running head at top, page number at top right, catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: Ea autem similiter est Enarthrosis, Arthrodia, & Symphysis.
Symphysis est ossium inter se unio sine motu.
Estque Sutura, vel Gomphosis, vel Harmonia.
Sutura est ossium Symphysis in modum serrae, unius dente in alterius sinum subeunte facta.
Gomphosis est ossium Symphysis, qua instar clavi ossi infigitur.
Harmonia est ossium Symphysis, facta per simplicem lineam.
main_text.head: CAPUT XXXII. OSTEOLOGIAM ET HUMANORUM OSSIUM SCELETON speciatim exponens.
SECTIO PRIMA. DE OSSIBUS CRANII.
main_text.p: Prima Sectio,Hactenus in genere de ossium partibus & conjunctione: nunc de ossium speciebus, seu humana Osteologia & Sceleto speciatim dispici-emus.

page.notes: The initial H is a woodcut. The first word is read as Hactenus. The word "ossiū" in the fourth-last line of the final paragraph is printed with a tilde over the u and is read as such. The head "CAPUT XXXII" is set in spaced capitals and is treated as one level-1 head with its title. Show-through from the reverse side is present in the centre and right of the page and is left out. The catchword "OS" is at the lower right.
